Content.Name: Wizard Content
Content.Label: Configure content
Content.Hint: Choose which compendiums the wizard uses, their priority, and which species and subclasses players can pick.
Content.SourcesHint: Compendiums with D&D content. Unchecked compendiums are ignored. When the same option is in more than one compendium, the one higher in this list wins. This world uses {rules} rules. Content tagged for the other ruleset is hidden unless you tick Any rules version for its compendium.
Content.SpeciesHint: Uncheck a species to hide it from players.
Content.SubclassesHint: Uncheck a subclass to hide it from players.
Content.NoPacks: No compendiums with classes, species, backgrounds or feats were found.
Content.NoSpecies: No species found for this world's rules.
Content.NoSubclasses: No subclasses found for this world's rules.
Content.LanguagesHint: Uncheck a language to hide it from the language choices in the wizard. Languages a species or background grants outright are still given. Modules that add languages show up as their own group, so you can switch a whole group off and re-enable the few you want.
Content.AnyRulesHint: Offer everything in this compendium whatever its 2014 or 2024 tag says. For homebrew or older content you want to use under this world's rules. Each entry is marked with its own rules version.

Untagged.Name: Content without a rules version
Untagged.Hint: Some homebrew or older content isn't marked as 2014 or 2024. Choose whether the wizard offers it.

AllowPlayers.Name: Players can use the wizard
AllowPlayers.Hint: When off, only the GM sees the Character Wizard buttons.

TashasAbilityScores.Name: Tasha's: customize racial ability score increases
TashasAbilityScores.Hint: 2014 rules only. For a species with fixed increases (for example +2 and +1), players get those points to spend on any abilities instead, with no more on one ability than the species' largest increase. The standard increases are preselected. Off by default.

CustomArrayEnabled.Name: Offer a custom ability score array
CustomArrayEnabled.Hint: Adds your own array as a way to set ability scores in the wizard, next to the standard array. Turn it on to edit the array below. Off by default.

CustomArray.Name: Custom array
CustomArray.Hint: Six scores separated by commas. Starts as the Dungeon Dudes' alternative array. Only used while the setting above is on.
CustomArray.Invalid: The custom ability score array must be six whole numbers from 1 to 20, for example 17, 15, 13, 12, 10, 8. Until it is, the wizard won't offer it.

RerollOnes.Name: 4d6: reroll 1s
RerollOnes.Hint: For old-school tables. When a player rolls 4d6 and drops the lowest, any die that shows a 1 is rolled again. Off by default.

Choices.Hint: {name} asks you to decide the following. Click an option's name to read about it, and tick it to choose it.
Choices.Inspect: Click an option's name to read what it does. Use its checkbox, or Choose here, to pick it.
Choices.Points: spend {count} points, {spent} spent, up to {cap} on one ability
Choices.Standard: Standard: {default}. Spend the points below to change them.
Choices.Taken: You already have this from an earlier choice.

Create.Failed: Character Wizard couldn't build the character. See the console for details.

Naming.AnotherOfKind: {kind}: you already have these, choose another

Abilities.Incomplete: Set all six ability scores to continue.

Hint.standard: Assign each of {values} to one ability.
Hint.custom: Assign each of {values} to one ability. This is the array your GM set up.
Hint.pointbuy: Spend up to {budget} points. Scores start at {min} and go up to {max} before bonuses.
Hint.roll: Roll once for all six scores. Each is four d6 with the lowest die dropped. Then assign each result to one ability.
Hint.manual: Type in each score, from 1 to 20, before bonuses.

Abilities.BonusNote: Bonuses from your species and background are added to the base scores.
